newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble steady, brief speculative fluctuations seen.
newsitem.headline: Rouble steady, brief speculative fluctuations seen.

text.p: The rouble was steady compared with late Wednesday, the previous working day in Russia, but dealers said it was subject to constant short-term speculative fluctuations.
Markets were closed on May 1 and 2 for public holidays.
roubles/dollar May 5 midday May 5 early Apr 30 close
"Dollar today rates fell in early trading but bounced back later on buying of those who expected the dip. It has been a good day for brief speculations," one dealer said.
United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said trading was otherwise quiet after holidays, ahead of another long weekend due to Victory Day on May 9.
